answer: A reputation trellis works like this: every agent starts with a crystal-clear public record of its past deals, and new agents can only enter the harbor of high-value work after a sponsor stakes tokens on them and co-signs their first transactions. If the newcomer cheats, the sponsor's stake is slashed and the newcomer's record is permanently marked. A Sybil attacker must fund a separate stake and find a separate sponsor for each fake identity, and a single fraud burns both the stake and the sponsor relationship, so mass-producing identities costs far more than any one scam can repay.
